thought.text: Now configure Apache as the front-end reverse proxy on 8080, and set xplan-webpages as the ROOT app of the Anwendungs-Tomcat (per the guide's tip):

reasoning_content:
Port configuration complete. Next, configure Apache httpd as a reverse proxy on port 8080:
- `/xplan-mapserver*` → MapServer CGI
- `/xplan-services-*`, `/xplan-webservices-*` → dienste 18080
- `/xplan-manager-*`, `/xplan-validator-web`, `/`, xplan-webpages → anwendung 18081
- `/xplan-manager-api`, `/xplan-validator-api`, `/xplan-dokumente-api` → api 18082

Also, the XPlanRessourcen root webapp (xplan-webpages) is on anwendung. Should it be placed as ROOT on anwendung? The guide recommends installing xplan-webpages as the ROOT webapp of the anwendungs-Tomcat (application Tomcat). Let's do that: copy the webpages war to ROOT.

After that, start apache on port 8080.

action.command:
# Make xplan-webpages the ROOT webapp of anwendung (guide tip)
rm -rf /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps/ROOT
cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-webpages.war /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps/ROOT.war
rm -f /opt/tomcat-anwendung/webapps/xplan-webpages.war
# Apache config
cat > /etc/apache2/sites-available/xplanbox.conf <<'EOF'
Listen 8080
<VirtualHost *:8080>
  ServerName localhost
  ProxyPreserveHost On
  ProxyRequests Off

  # MapServer WMS raster OWS (CGI)
  ScriptAlias /xplan-mapserver /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper
  <Files "mapserv-wrapper">
    Require all granted
  </Files>

  # Dienste-Tomcat
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wms/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wms/
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wfs-syn/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wfs-syn/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wfs/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wfs/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs/
  ProxyPass /xplan-webservices-validator-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-validator-wms/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-webservices-validator-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-validator-wms/
  ProxyPass /xplan-webservices-inspireplu/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-inspireplu/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-webservices-inspireplu/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-webservices-inspireplu/

  # API-Tomcat
  ProxyPass /xplan-manager-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-manager-api/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-manager-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-manager-api/
  ProxyPass /xplan-validator-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-validator-api/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-validator-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-validator-api/
  ProxyPass /xplan-dokumente-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-dokumente-api/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-dokumente-api/ http://127.0.0.1:18082/xplan-dokumente-api/

  # Anwendungs-Tomcat
  ProxyPass /xplan-manager-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-manager-web/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-manager-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-manager-web/
  ProxyPass /xplan-validator-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-validator-web/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-validator-web/ http://127.0.0.1:18081/xplan-validator-web/
  ProxyPass / http://127.0.0.1:18081/
  ProxyPassReverse / http://127.0.0.1:18081/

  ErrorLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/xplanbox-error.log
  CustomLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/xplanbox-access.log combined
</VirtualHost>
EOF
a2dissite 000-default 2>/dev/null; a2ensite xplanbox 2>&1 | tail -1
sed -i 's/^\(Listen 80\)$/Listen 8080/' /etc/apache2/ports.conf
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -2
